deathmatch.description: Most kills wins. With teams on, every kill counts for your team, so stick together.

elimination.description: No respawns. The last one standing takes the round (or the last team, with teams on).

gun_game.description: Each kill moves you to the next weapon; a kill with the last one wins. With teams on, the team moves up together.

juggernaut.description: One fighter is the Juggernaut: red, 500 health, 200 shield. Whoever kills the Juggernaut becomes it.
